sourceFile: 30.3.MSU-L20S15-07 Result test new material center Dome from GES TRADING date 24.8.2025_clean.xlsx

aiVerification.summary: Draft has citeable source evidence but misgroups the changed factor and includes many invalid parsed measurement outcomes.
issues: Changed factor mixes vendor and laser subconditions instead of separating primary vendor change with laser/no-laser context.
Baseline/test labels conflict across Normal Ralon, CD KR, and GES TRADING comparisons.
Many measurement outcomes are parsed from headers or IDs, not actual metric values.
FO and NTI statistics appear numerically invalid and over-aggregated.
Some cited rows are headers only and insufficient for claimed results.
correctionPlan: Set primary factor to center dome/CD material vendor GES TRADING versus normal/Ralon or CD KR as supported per section.
Keep laser versus no-laser as subgroup/process condition, with separate results where shown.
Rebuild outcomes from real result rows: VP+CD assembly, tension, function NG, NTI SPL/THD/IMP, and FO.
Remove header-derived and malformed measurement stats.
Cite both header/context rows and the exact data rows used for each comparison.
aiVerification.evidencePolicy: Row citations exist but are not sufficient because many support only headers or malformed aggregations.
